description: Agent Waste and Recycling Records: submit recycling processing records with the inbound, outbound, facility and residue disposal records they answer to: the facility record with its reference, name and the material types it lists; each inbound manifest or pickup record with its id, reference, its kind (manifest or pickup), material, quantity received and the moment received; each processing entry with its id, reference, the inbound record it processes, material, the quantity recorded as recycled, the residue and the moment processed; each outbound shipment with its id, reference, material, quantity and the moment shipped; each residue disposal record with its id, reference, the processing entry it disposes of, quantity and the moment disposed. The signed report gives the processing record and the records behind it, each entry recording material as recycled against the inbound manifest or pickup record behind it, the outbound quantity of each material against what the processing record recycled of it, each entry’s material against the facility record, and each residue against the disposal record behind it, and counts them, and names divergent recycling records: material recorded as recycled with no inbound manifest or pickup record behind it, outbound material quantities the processing record’s totals do not reflect, a recycling entry for a material type the facility record does not list, and residue recorded with no disposal record behind it; then a processing entry handling more than the inbound record it names and a disposal record naming a processing entry the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No processing entries, no inbound records beside recycled material, no material types in the facility record, or no disposal records beside residue leaves those points unverified. Records match by letters and digits, materials match by their words with plurals folded, so Corrugated boxes and corrugated box are one material, quantities read to the hundredth, and outbound above what was recycled is unreflected. This reads whether all material recorded as recycled came in on a manifest or pickup, went out as recorded and left its residue disposed of. Verdict waste_recycling_record_divergent, waste_recycling_record_partial, waste_recycling_record_unverified or waste_recycling_record_consistent. POST /api/waste-recycling-record-check. Reads the waste and recycling records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it hauls no waste, operates no facility, contacts no regulator, hauler or disposal site and issues no permit or certification, which stay with the waste operation, its haulers, its facilities and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Waste and Recycling Records reads a waste operation’s own records: waste manifest records, hauler permit records, disposal and landfill records, recycling processing records, diversion and recovery records, pickup and collection log records, facility and scale records and contamination report records, each against the hauler permit, facility, receiving and disposal records, the waste types, areas and dates in the pickup log, the manifests and the dates the record states, the inbound, outbound and residue records, the processing, reuse, disposal and pickup totals, the service record, the scale tickets and dispositions, or the follow-up entries and the inspected load counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the waste stream: what the manifest shows, what the disposal record supports, what the permits cover, and whether the diversion claims and pickup logs hold up; it reads records about waste streams and the people who move them, not live environmental monitoring and not cleanup services: the Agent Energy family reads utility and generation records, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file and the Agent Aviation Records family reads an air operator’s flight and maintenance paper trail, while this family reads a waste operation’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-waste-recycling-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-waste-recycling-records/.
